name: UQ School of Agriculture and Food Sustainability Placement Enabling Grant
provider: University of Queensland, School of Agriculture and Food Sustainability
summary: Grant towards the travel and accommodation costs of placements for UQ agriculture and food sustainability students.
who: Can show financial impost from your placement.
Domestic or international, enrolled in at least a 50% load in an approved program.
Doing placements of at least 120 hours in total in the year of the award.
how: Submit the online application form with placement dates, location, accommodation and travel costs.
catches: Allocated four times a year. Closing dates are 31 January, 30 April, 31 July and 31 October, at 11.59pm AEST.
